stem: Mimi’s essay does not have a strong position statement. Which of the following sentences should replace sentence 6 to serve as an effective position statement?

options.label: A
options.text: It’s foolish to buy several bottles of water each day when there’s no good reason for doing this.

options.label: B
options.text: People need to stop doing this now and protest against bottled-water companies.

options.label: C
options.text: These problems can be solved, however, if people choose to drink water from reusable containers instead of plastic bottles.

options.label: D
options.text: The list of problems that people are causing, such as increasing pollution, by buying bottled water is endless.
